purpose: Single source of truth for the governance spine byte-identity check. Read by scripts/knowledge-equivalence-report.py (ISO-1), scripts/verify-knowledge-conformance.ts (CONF-1) and tests/knowledge/equivalence.test.ts. A spine file absent from this list fails the check; there is no fall-back to the baseline hash. Approving a change means editing this one file, with the reason, in a reviewed commit.

src/orchestrator.ts.approved_change: Gateway and MI9 convergence (#37): the MI9 gate is evaluated on every inference request and the resulting act is deposited in the audit chain, so reported sovereignty is derived from gate 1 instead of asserted.

src/audit/hash-chain.ts.approved_change: Audit-mirror hook (#30): one fire-and-forget call inside append(), after the local insert and before the return. The local chain stays authoritative; hashing, ordering, verification and export are untouched, and the mirror can neither block nor throw into this path.

src/governance/mi9-gate.ts.approved_change: Deny-by-default repair of gate 2 (41b70ac, 18 September 2026), on top of the D-1 repair. An unlisted domain previously resolved to tier 'limited', which is not a co-sign tier, so authority was granted by omission. The tier now comes from the most specific classified ancestor, a domain with no classified ancestor is refused, and every gate-2 finding records the rule it matched. 41b70ac re-pinned only the Jest test; this file closes the drift in ISO-1 and CONF-1.
